s: Today is review day, so we will play with ten words from the last three days.
We just use the words we know, in real talk.
Fish and chips is my favorite food on a Friday.
Fish and chips is so good.
Do you eat fish and chips at home, or do you buy it at a shop?
I buy it at a small shop, but at home I cook fish in a frying pan.
I use my frying pan every day, for eggs and for fish.
And with lunch, I drink fruit juice.
Fruit juice is cold and sweet.
I like orange fruit juice best.
I eat a lot of fruit, and fruit is good for you.
Now let us talk about health.
My diet has fish, fruit, and fruit juice.
A good diet means the food and drink you eat every day.
I watch my diet, and I run three times a week.
When I run, my chest feels warm and strong.
Your chest is the front of your body.
Put your hand on your chest.
Your chest moves up and down.
I go to the dentist two times a year.
The dentist is kind and helps my teeth stay clean.
A good dentist tells you how to look after your teeth.
Do you go to the dentist every year?
Do you do any sport, Lena?
I play tennis on the court.
The court is near my home, and the court is big and clean.
I play tennis on the court too.
Do you do any sport on the court with your friends?
We play on the court on Sunday, and then we eat fish and chips together.
Do you do any camping in the summer?
We sleep in a tent and cook in a frying pan at the camp.
Camping is fun and good for the body.
